members.description: Owns APIs, the database, Stripe billing and webhooks, authentication, and server performance or errors.

members.name: Nora
members.title: Copywriter
members.description: Writes and edits marketing copy, headlines, launch emails, announcements and help text; keeps tone consistent.

members.name: Quinn
members.title: QA
members.description: Tests builds end to end, reproduces reported bugs, files clear bug reports, and verifies fixes before a release.

members.name: Chief of Staff
members.description: Coordinates the team: plans, schedules, deadlines, status updates, who is doing what, and re-planning when priorities change.

members.name: Sol
members.title: Sales
members.description: Prospecting, lead lists, first-touch and follow-up outreach emails, booking demos with prospects, and keeping the CRM pipeline stages up to date.

members.name: Ada
members.title: Accounting
members.description: Invoices and their payment status, bookkeeping, expenses, reconciling Stripe payouts with the bank, and tax documents.

members.name: Kai
members.title: Customer Support
members.description: Answers customer questions and complaints, handles customer refund requests, and keeps help-centre articles accurate.

members.name: Lex
members.title: Legal
members.description: Reviews contracts and NDAs, drafts terms of service and privacy policy language, and flags regulatory issues.

members.name: Ops

members.name: Sec

members.name: Data
